title: Lead I - Software Testing(Cypress)
description:
**Role description**  


We are looking for an experienced Cypress Automation Test Engineer with 6\+ years of overall testing experience and strong hands\-on expertise in designing, developing, and maintaining automation solutions using Cypress.



The ideal candidate should have strong proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript, experience in frontend and backend testing, REST API validation, database testing, and CI/CD integration. The candidate should also possess strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving capabilities and be comfortable working within an Agile/Scrum delivery environment.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using Cypress.
* Develop scalable and reusable automation frameworks and test components.
* Perform frontend and backend functional testing, including manual testing when required.
* Perform REST API testing using Cypress and/or Postman.
* Validate backend data and application functionality using SQL queries.
* Analyze test execution results, identify defects, and perform root\-cause analysis.
* Debug automation failures and work closely with development teams to resolve application and test\-related issues.
* Integrate automated test suites with CI/CD pipelines.
* Manage automation code and test assets using Git/Bitbucket.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, grooming, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with developers, product owners, business analysts, and other QA team members to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
* Identify opportunities to improve test automation coverage, execution efficiency, and overall product quality.

**Mandatory Skills \& Experience**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience in software testing / quality engineering.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Cypress automation testing.
* Strong programming/scripting skills in JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Good experience in frontend and backend manual testing.
* Experience with REST API testing using Cypress and/or Postman.
* Good knowledge of SQL and experience performing database validations.
* Hands\-on experience with Git and/or Bitbucket for version control.
* Experience integrating and executing automated tests through at least one CI/CD platform such as:
	+ Jenkins
	+ Azure DevOps
	+ GitHub Actions
	+ GitLab CI/CD
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodology.
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.

Good to Have / Preferred Skills
* Experience with Playwright automation testing.
* Experience working on projects within the Retail domain.
* Experience developing or enhancing automation frameworks.
* Exposure to end\-to\-end testing involving UI, API, and database layers.


  

**Skills**  

Cypress, Bitbucket, Git, Postman

 **About UST**  

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future\-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

title: Junior Node.js Developer
description:
We are looking for a Junior Node.js Developer with 0–6 months of experience to join our development team. The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in JavaScript and Node.js, along with a good understanding of databases and a willingness to learn and grow.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Develop, maintain, and enhance applications using **Node.js**.
* Write clean, efficient, and maintainable JavaScript code.
* Work with **MySQL** for database operations and data management.
* Understand and implement basic database design concepts.
* Use commonly used **NPM packages** and understand their purpose and usage.
* Collaborate with team members to develop and deliver software solutions.
* Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues.
* Follow coding standards, best practices, and development guidelines.
* Continuously learn new technologies and improve technical skills.

**Required Skills**


* Basic to good knowledge of **Node.js**.
* Strong understanding of **JavaScript concepts**, including advanced JavaScript fundamentals.
* Good understanding of **MySQL** and database concepts.
* Knowledge of basic database design and database operations.
* Familiarity with commonly used **NPM packages**.
* Good problem\-solving and logical\-thinking skills.
* Strong willingness to learn and develop skills in Node.js.

**Experience**


**0–6 months of experience** in Node.js development.


Freshers with relevant projects, internships, or strong practical knowledge of Node.js may also be considered.


Education


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in **Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field** is preferred.
